license_note: At review time no weights are published and no weights license text exists: the announcement says the weights will be released under an Apache 2.0 license later this month, and early access is limited to a waitlisted group on terms the announcement does not publish. The release is classified proprietary today. Re-review when the weights and their license text ship.

license_evidence.scope: Limited early access to Beam through a waitlist; no weights or weights license published as of the review date, and the announced Apache 2.0 license is a stated intention only

access_boundary: This record represents Beam as announced on 2026-10-05: the early version made available to a select, waitlisted group of users, not a generally available API or published weights. The weights, technical report, model card, and developer artifacts promised for later in October 2026, the distribution partners and open-source integrations promised at launch, the later models in the series, and downstream quantizations remain separate boundaries. The announcement says Beam is undergoing final red-teaming and evaluations, and gives 256K tokens as the maximum context length during reinforcement learning and 1M tokens as the effective context length after midtraining.
strengths: First-party announcement published on release day with architecture, training-data and compute figures, a benchmark table naming its comparison models and the method of its efficiency comparison
Reflection commits to releasing weights under Apache 2.0 together with documentation and a full stack for running, evaluating, and fine-tuning the model
tradeoffs: Early access only: no weights, license text, model card, technical report, or third-party hosting exist yet, so artifact availability and portability rest on a promise
The announcement says final red-teaming and evaluations are still under way, and it publishes no model identifier, API model page, or pricing

evidence.label: Official Beam announcement: architecture, early-access status, and the Apache 2.0 weights commitment
Reflection Open Safety Framework page: framework text that names no model

source_metadata.name: Beam
source_metadata.description: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts text model with 501 billion total and 23 billion active parameters for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads
